failures.recovery: Three explicit line-bounded reads covered all 1,498 lines; a typed JSON check confirmed all 210 rows and the Elowen-to-Sylven edge.

failures.title: Referenced legacy canonical helpers absent

failures.title: Node 24 TXT syntax-check extension rejection
failures.subject: node --check rejected an executable TXT path with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION before evaluating its JavaScript syntax.
failures.recovery: A bounded CommonJS vm.Script over Module.wrap checks the same exact TXT bytes without executing the helper or renaming the file.

failures.title: Planning wrapper output omission
failures.subject: The planning builder completed and wrote its receipt, but the command wrapper returned no attributable console payload.
failures.recovery: Exact filesystem, receipt, Git-status, and head probes established 31 planning files at the unchanged parent without rerunning the builder or oracle.
